run_convert_voxtral_realtime: run the CLI script to convert VoxtralRealtime weights from original format to Hugging Face format
build_convert_model_weights: build a converted Hugging Face model by calling write_model with input repo, model name, config name, and output directory
create_voxtral_realtime_processor: create and save a VoxtralRealtimeProcessor combining MistralCommonBackend tokenizer and VoxtralRealtimeFeatureExtractor
refactor_convert_config: refactor convert_config to map original config dict into a VoxtralRealtimeConfig with text and audio sub-configs
review_convert_state_dict: review convert_state_dict to map old state dict keys to new HF keys and permute q_proj and k_proj weights for RoPE
